The '''Rhamphorhynchus''' (plural: Rhamphorhynchi) is an [[Extinction|extinct]] flying reptile (or pterosaur) from the [[wikipedia:Jurassic|Jurassic]] era. They can be found in savage tropical dry leaf forests. Like all flying [[creature]]s, they possess a legendary [[skill]] in [[climbing]]. If tamed, they can be made into [[exotic pet]]s, with a low pet value of 50. [[Egg]]s can be harvested from them, with amounts laid being between 4-8. When attacking, their ferocious jaws - as their description would indicate - give them very dangerous biting attacks, as well as the ability to scratch and snatch creatures with their talons. They are the smallest extinct non-[[vermin]] creature in the game.

Some [[Dwarf|dwarves]] [[like]] rhamphorhynchi for their ''ferocious jaws''.
